subject.description: Primary teaching subject of the page.

usable.description: True when the page can produce a lesson, false when declined.

declineCode.description: Empty string when usable, otherwise the decline reason code.

declineSummary.description: Empty string when usable, otherwise 10 to 280 characters of plain text saying why the page cannot be used.

pageCoverage.description: What the page covers, 10 to 300 characters of plain text, always present.

headline.description: AI-written headline in plain text, 10 to 120 characters. Empty string only when the analysis declined.

id.description: Lowercase kebab id for this key point, 40 characters or fewer.

point.description: AI-written point in plain text, 10 to 200 characters.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer.

keyPoints.description: Key points, empty only when declined.

id.description: Lowercase kebab id for this key term, 40 characters or fewer.

term.description: Term as named on the page, 1 to 40 characters.

gloss.description: AI-written gloss in plain text, 5 to 120 characters.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer.

keyTerms.description: Key terms, empty only when declined.

componentId.description: Planned component or activity id in teaching order.

pedagogicalReason.description: Why this component fits now, 10 to 160 characters of plain text.

focusQuote.description: Verbatim focus passage from the source, 1 to 150 characters. Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis.

focusSourceId.description: Id of the source the focus quote was copied from.

componentPlan.description: Teaching plan in order, empty only when declined.
